name: Agility Medical Group LLC
old_description: From your brain to your joints, moving every day has the power to improve every part of your body. But when pain and injury get in the way of your goals, we provide you with the best equipment in the industry to get you Back in the Game of Life™ faster.
about:
Agility Medical Group LLC operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, as a distributor of non-operative, post-surgical, and preventative orthopedic rehabilitation equipment. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm procures and supplies products from manufacturers such as DonJoy, Aircast, and Kinex Medical Company, offering bracing, cold therapy, and continuous passive motion (CPM) systems for knee, shoulder, and other joints. It maintains a network of regional representatives across Oklahoma and Kansas to serve medical professionals and patients directly, and manages a structured rental and return program for CPM machines.

Customers include orthopedic surgeons, physical therapists, sports medicine clinics, and individual patients recovering from surgery or injury. The company emphasizes patient resources, including a dedicated return process for rented equipment and a representative locator tool.

Agility Medical Group states its mission is to provide premium products and outstanding service while fostering a positive work environment through the Character Core character-development program and the Great Game of Business open-book management model. Community involvement events further reflect its stated goal of helping people return to active lifestyles.
